reason: I already have a supplement I reorder when it runs out, and I don't go looking to swap. The lab report and the sachets are nice for travel, but it's a brand I've never heard of and I'm not changing a routine that works for an unknown.
objection: Is it really tested, or just marketing? A report on a product page from a brand I've never heard of is still the brand's own claim until I can see it's real, and I have no reason to leave what I already take.
would_change_my_mind: A trusted friend or a creator I follow who actually uses it on trips and shows the lab report is real, plus a cheap single-box trial that I can try without dropping my current supplement.
